spec.failure_policy: One attempt per request. Retain failures; no automatic retry or answer repair.
spec.primary_score: Correct status and amount within frozen tolerance, on all selected cases.
spec.format_score: Strict one-object JSON and exact schema, reported separately.
spec.grounding_score: Source-ID validity, whitespace-normalized literal quote matching, and copied-number/explicit-zero checks, reported separately. These do not establish semantic support or correct scale.

extra.design: 25 purposively selected questions in nine official source packets, published 13-22 October 2026. One RRF packet (3 questions) is development; 8 packets (22 questions) are held out. No stochastic answer repeats.
extra.selection: All cases, gold, exact source text, prompts and 150 request hashes frozen before the first development call. Test results do not determine inclusion.
extra.review: UK/US source gold independently checked by methods_literature; annual report gold independently checked by fiscal_notebook; EU packets source checked by their author and root. These are agent reviews of documentary evidence, not independent human coding.
extra.precision: Numeric questions ask published amounts or arithmetic on displayed values. Tight fixed absolute tolerance only; no relative tolerance. Rounding of underlying quantities is described separately.
extra.primary_comparison: Within each exact model, ledger minus direct correct-answer rate on all 22 held-out questions. Invalid requests remain wrong. No cross-currency averaging of money errors.
extra.uncertainty: 10,000 paired packet-cluster bootstrap resamples, seed 22061022; resample 8 complete packet clusters with replacement and recompute case-weighted difference. Degenerate intervals from zero disagreements do not prove equivalence.
known_limitations: Most packets contain one report; excerpt selection is supplied, not an open-web retrieval task
Recent publication does not prove every underlying financial fact was previously unseen
Unknown is conditional on supplied documents
Medium effort labels are not guaranteed equal reasoning budgets across vendors
No measured human review time or downstream economic regression
